title: Never Truly Out of Fashion: A Retrospective Look at Evaluation in NLG
authors_zh: Patrícia Schmidtová, Saad Mahamood, Ondřej Dušek
paper_type_zh: NLG 评测实践的纵向语料审计研究
best_for_zh: 需要制定 LLM judge 校准、人工评估或评测术语审计方案的研究者。
one_line: Reviews evaluation practice and the incomplete human validation of LLM judges.
基于跨七十年论文语料，量化 NLG 评测中人工评估、LLM judge 与评测标准的长期演变。
why: It adds a paper-backed reliability or failure-mode surface to Track 13.
inclusion_reason: Track 13: evaluator/reward/verifier reliability, attack, uncertainty, or reward-hacking research.

title: Problem
问题
html:
As automatic metrics and LLM judges make NLG evaluation cheap, it is unclear whether they are replacing human evaluation and which criteria the field is actually using. That uncertainty makes it hard to judge whether fast automated feedback is calibrated rather than merely convenient.

The paper audits this question with a longitudinal, paper-level analysis of ACL Anthology NLG research. It identifies human, automatic, and LLM-judge evaluation signals and tracks their use by year, venue, task, criterion, and annotation method; its output is an audit dataset and baseline, not a new evaluator.

自动指标和 LLM judge 降低了 NLG 评测成本，但它们是否正在替代人工评估、领域究竟采用了哪些评测标准仍不清楚。若只因反馈便宜就使用自动评测，研究者便难以判断该信号是否经过校准，还是仅仅方便。

论文以 ACL Anthology 的 NLG 研究为对象进行逐论文纵向审计，识别人工、自动和 LLM judge 的评测信号，并按年份、会议、任务、标准与标注方法追踪变化。其产物是审计数据和领域基线，而非一个新的评测器。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The contribution is a reproducible longitudinal audit of 24,291 NLG papers (1952–2025): precision-oriented regular expressions convert paper text into evaluation-modality and criterion signals, then reveal how human evaluation, LLM judges, and vocabulary changed. The released dataset contains paper IDs, metadata, and extracted signals rather than copyrighted full text; code reconstructs the corpus from ACL sources. The key audit finding is not that LLM judges replace people, but that their rapid adoption leaves a sizable unvalidated segment requiring human calibration.
论文的核心贡献是对 1952–2025 年 24,291 篇 NLG 论文开展可复现的纵向审计：以偏重精确率的正则表达式将论文文本转换为评测方式和标准信号，再刻画人工评估、LLM judge 与术语的变化。公开数据只含论文 ID、元数据和抽取信号，不含受版权保护的全文；代码可从 ACL 来源重建语料。关键审计结论并非 LLM judge 已取代人，而是其快速扩张留下了一块缺少人工校准的使用区域。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Assemble corpus. The authors combine ACL-OCL up to part of 2022 with a crawl of nine core venues thereafter, deduplicate 85,792 papers, then retain generative-task papers with evaluation signals.
  1. Detect signals. Precision-prioritized regular expressions search title, abstract, and when available full text for human, automatic, and LLM-judge evaluation; criterion patterns follow Howcroft et al. (2020).
  1. Aggregate and audit. Paper-level signals are grouped by year, venue, and task to compute prevalence and trends. Each criterion is counted at most once per paper; no score determines paper inclusion.
  1. Release and reproduce. The repository releases IDs, metadata, extracted signals, and scripts, not full texts; it can redownload permitted ACL papers. Post-2022 venue coverage and unavailable full text must be fixed when reproducing.

1. 构建语料。作者将部分 2022 年前的 ACL-OCL 与其后九个核心会议的爬取结果合并，去重后得到 85,792 篇论文，再保留生成任务且含评测信号的论文。
  1. 抽取信号。以偏重精确率的正则表达式检索标题、摘要及可获得的全文，识别人工、自动和 LLM judge 评测；标准模式依据 Howcroft 等人的分类体系。
  1. 汇总审计。将逐论文信号按年份、会议和任务分组，计算使用比例与趋势；每项标准每篇至多计一次，没有分数决定论文去留。
  1. 发布复现。仓库公开 ID、元数据、抽取信号和脚本，不公开全文；脚本可从 ACL 重建许可范围内的语料。复现时必须固定 2022 年后的会议覆盖和全文可得性。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Claim: LLM judges are growing quickly but mostly complement, rather than replace, human evaluation. In the 24,291-paper corpus, 109 papers used LLM judges in 2024 and 224 in 2025, versus 19 in 2023 (Results, §3). Of instruction-tuned-judge papers, 61.4% also reported human evaluation and 86.2% of that subset mentioned validation/manual checking; therefore 38.6% used a judge without reported human evaluation. This supports a calibration gap in the audited literature, not an estimate of true judge accuracy or a causal claim about all NLG research.

主张是 LLM judge 正在快速增长，但主要仍是人工评估的补充而非替代。在 24,291 篇语料中，使用 LLM judge 的论文从 2023 年的 19 篇升至 2024 年 109 篇、2025 年 224 篇（结果第 3 节）。其中 61.4% 同时报告人工评估，该子集的 86.2% 提到验证或人工检查；因此 38.6% 未报告人工评估。该证据支持被审计文献存在校准缺口，不能估计 judge 的真实准确率，也不能推出全部 NLG 研究的因果结论。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work studies metric validity or individual human-evaluation practices, often for a task or period. This paper changes the unit of analysis to a seven-decade ACL corpus and jointly traces modality, criteria, task, and annotation-method signals, including the recent LLM-judge transition. Its contribution is not a validated per-paper classifier: the patterns measure terminology and reported practice, and the authors explicitly retain precision over recall. The reusable novelty is the transparent audit protocol and longitudinal baseline.
既有工作多研究某项指标的有效性或某个任务、时期的人工评估实践。本文将分析单位改为跨七十年的 ACL 语料，同时追踪评测方式、标准、任务和标注方法信号，并纳入近期 LLM judge 转向。其新意不是训练出经验证的逐论文分类器：这些模式测量术语与报告实践，作者明确选择精确率优先而非高召回。可复用的创新是透明审计协议和纵向基线。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Keyword detection can produce false positives from related-work/background mentions and false negatives for unusual terminology (Limitations). Before using a prevalence number as a behavioral claim, manually audit a stratified sample and report precision/recall for the new domain.

The post-2022 crawl covers only nine core venues, and full-text availability is uneven. This can distort comparisons involving smaller venues or recent years; reuse must preserve the corpus snapshot and report coverage rather than treating absent signals as absent practice.

关键词检测会把相关工作或背景中的提及误判为实践，也会漏掉非常规术语（局限部分）。若要把使用比例解释为真实行为，须对新领域做分层人工抽查，并报告 precision 与 recall。

2022 年后的爬取只覆盖九个核心会议，且全文可得性不均衡。这会扭曲小型会议或近期年份的比较；复用时应固定语料快照并报告覆盖范围，不能把未发现信号当作未发生实践。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For an evaluation lead deciding whether to deploy an LLM judge, use the released protocol to inventory papers or internal reports: collect identifiers and text, run the modality/criterion patterns, then sample-check detected judge cases. The output is a coverage and calibration report that can require a human-judgment comparison where none is reported. Do not use it to certify an individual judge or infer benchmark correctness; it audits reporting and terminology, not output quality.
若负责决定是否部署 LLM judge，可用该协议盘点论文或内部报告：收集标识符与文本，运行评测方式和标准模式，再抽样核查被识别的 judge 案例。输出是覆盖率与校准报告，可要求未报告人工对照的项目补做比较。它不适合认证单个 judge，也不能推断 benchmark 正确性；其审计对象是报告实践和术语，不是模型输出质量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: a longitudinal audit, not an evaluator, of how NLG papers report evaluation.
  2. Lever: corpus filtering followed by precision-oriented regex extraction; extraction quality, not a model score, governs the evidence.
  3. Artifact: public repository releases IDs, metadata, and extracted signals; raw full text is excluded for copyright.
  4. Anchor: 224 LLM-judge papers in 2025; 38.6% lacked reported human evaluation, a reporting-calibration gap.
  5. Reuse: audit local practice and mandate human calibration; first validate patterns on a sampled target corpus.

1. 定位：它审计 NLG 论文如何报告评测，不是一个评测器。
  2. 抓手：先过滤语料，再用偏重精确率的正则抽取；证据质量取决于抽取而非模型分数。
  3. Artifact：公开仓库提供 ID、元数据和抽取信号，因版权不含全文。
  4. 锚点：2025 年有 224 篇使用 LLM judge，38.6% 未报告人工评估，指向报告层面的校准缺口。
  5. 复用：用于审计本地实践并要求人工校准；先在目标语料抽样验证模式。
